text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
With this, the progress presentation has 
come to an end. 
Thank you for your hard work, 
Trainer-sama.
choice_data_list:
Thank you for your hard work as well, 
Azuma-san.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... 
Shall we now attend to our final duty?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
What we hold here are the ancient 
teachings and the new teachings. 
This is a rite to bind the two together.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
So that past learnings shall never leave 
our Shinme, 
and new wisdom may take root within them.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
In a manner of speaking, we offer our 
prayers 
that fundamentals and practical 
application may become one.
choice_data_list: So that the Shinme can excel even further?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. 
...I ask that you join in, offering a 
prayer of your own.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
――Humbly we pray for divine protection and 
grace.

I stand beside her and close my eyes. 
Praying that the Shinme may continue to 
flourish and excel.

Next year, we will help the Shinme grow 
once again 
built upon these 'teachings'... as we 
weave the lessons of the past 
together with the wisdom of the new.
